name: ClipDrop Relight
summary: ClipDrop Relight uses AI to relight and edit video scenes, enhancing visuals without reshooting. Perfect for post-production and creative projects.
description: ClipDrop Relight uses AI to relight and edit video scenes, enhancing visuals without reshooting. Perfect for post-production and creative projects. Relight your photos automatically with AI AI relighting: Change the lighting conditions in your video after filming, adding drama or correcting bad lighting. Color grading: Instantly adjust the mood, tone, and color palette for a polished professional look. Object removal: Effortlessly erase unwanted elements from your shots without complex editing skills. Web-based editor: Edit videos in the cloud, with no need for high-powered local hardware.

features: AI relighting: Change the lighting conditions in your video after filming, adding drama or correcting bad lighting.
Color grading: Instantly adjust the mood, tone, and color palette for a polished professional look.
Object removal: Effortlessly erase unwanted elements from your shots without complex editing skills.
Web-based editor: Edit videos in the cloud, with no need for high-powered local hardware.

howToUse.title: Go to ClipDrop Relight
howToUse.description: Visit ClipDrop’s Relight tool online. No installation is needed; all editing is done in the browser.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Video or Image
howToUse.description: Click 'Upload' and select the video or image file you want to relight or enhance.

howToUse.title: Adjust Lighting
howToUse.description: Use the relight controls to add, move, or adjust virtual light sources. Instantly see the effect on your scene.

howToUse.title: Apply Color Grading and Effects
howToUse.description: Experiment with color grading sliders and filters to achieve the desired mood and style.

howToUse.title: Remove Objects (Optional)
howToUse.description: If needed, use the object removal tool to erase unwanted elements from your video or image.

howToUse.title: Preview & Download
howToUse.description: Preview your enhanced video or image. Download the result in your chosen format directly from the web editor.

features_fr: Rééclairage IA : modifiez les conditions d'éclairage de votre vidéo après le tournage, en ajoutant du drame ou en corrigeant un mauvais éclairage.
Étalonnage des couleurs : ajustez instantanément l’ambiance, le votre et la palette de couleurs pour un look professionnel raffiné.
Suppression d'objets : effacez sans effort les éléments indésirables de vos photos sans compétences d'édition complexes.
Éditeur Web : éditez des vidéos dans le cloud, sans avoir besoin de matériel local puissant.
